title: Crew face dismiss is a hover-reveal corner badge
eyebrow: Web · Wisconsin Creative · Event detail Crew
lede: Assigned photos and empty pluses stay a clean 24px face at rest. Unassign and Remove appear as an 18px disc centered on the trailing-top corner when the row is hovered.

stats.n: Hit box centered on the face corner; disc is 18px.
Pointer-events none on sm, so Assign still receives the click.
Clear-button center matches plus and avatar top-right in CDP.

sections.heading: Rest versus hover
sections.note: Matched Playwright crops of the same Event detail rows. This is rest vs hover of the new control, not a historical before of the covering 28px X. That baseline was not captured in an isolated worktree.

pairs.title: Assigned avatar
pairs.afterCap: 18px disc on the trailing-top corner; initials stay readable.

pairs.title: Empty plus
pairs.beforeCap: Dashed plus and Assign. No dismiss chip.
pairs.afterCap: Same 18px disc on the plus corner; the plus stays visible.

changes.was: A 16px (earlier 28px) disc sat on the photo with only a 4px offset, so most of the badge covered the avatar or the plus.
changes.now: An 18px disc is centered on the trailing-top corner of a shared 24px face frame. Empty slots overlay that frame on Assign’s plus.

changes.h: The X was always in the way
changes.was: Visible at rest, and a hidden-but-present control could still steal the Assign click.
changes.now: Opacity 0 and pointer-events none at rest on pointer screens. Row hover, row focus-within, and keyboard focus reveal it. Overflow menus keep Unassign and Remove.

verification: Playwright hover on the assigned Erik Role row: opacity 0 at rest, 1 on hover. Crop 1070×45.
Playwright hover on an open Student slot: overlay box matches the plus (24×24 at the same origin); clear center is the plus top-right. Opacity 0 at rest, 1 on hover.
Authenticated Event detail rest screenshot: pluses and avatars are clean; no X visible.
Did not click Unassign or Remove on the live Football vs Eastern Michigan crew.
tests/schedule-ui-polish-source.test.ts: 7 passed. ESLint clean on crew-row.tsx and WorkingCrewEditor.tsx.
`npx tsc --noEmit` still fails only on unrelated src/lib/services/blasts.ts payload Json.
notes: These pairs compare rest vs hover of the new badge. The previous covering-X state was not snapshotted in an isolated baseline.
Badge close-ups badge-assigned-close.png and badge-placeholder-close.png are 24×25 hit-target crops, not matched pairs.
Native iOS Event detail is unchanged.
